rules: Stop proposing new normalizations of $dollar_volume alone. Every such aggregate this round clustered at |t| 0.72-0.82 on the cheap window: TS_SUM($return*$dollar_volume), TS_MAX/TS_SUM, TS_COV with $return, SIGN counts, and TS_RANK crossed with $leverage all failed, and the two that passed reached only 0.715 and 0.824 fitness. That family is exhausted on this island.

Try the bare field or a single-operator version before deep nesting. Raw $volume scored 3.839 while every multi-operator $dollar_volume transform scored under 0.9; the extra structure paid the complexity charge without earning it back.

Spend the round in the mixed niche (fundamental rank against an intraday-range term). It produced the two best results by a wide margin: RANK($roa) versus a 21d low/high position at 4.355, and CS_RANK($accrual_gap) with a range/open ratio at 2.884. The price_volume/high niche is saturated near the gate.

Cross-sectionally normalize both legs before combining them. RANK($roa) minus a ranked price term scored 4.355; the same fundamental multiplied by a raw unbounded price ratio scored 0.20 on the cheap screen. Never combine a rank with an unnormalized signed price quantity.
Keep lookbacks at 21 bars or fewer. Accepted expressions used only 2 and 21 bar windows; 42, 63, 126, and 189 bar lookbacks appeared exclusively in rejected proposals.
Drop conditional regime splits. The single IF_ELSE proposal, switching between short-horizon reversal and momentum on high-low versus its 21d mean, had the worst cheap screen of the round at 0.48.

RANK($roa) is too small to serve as a crossover parent. Both children built around it kept almost none of it while adding long-window volatility and price-extreme terms. Graft it whole as one operand of a larger donor expression, or cross from a bigger parent subtree instead.

Normalize intraday-range terms by a raw OHLC field, as the accepted ones do with $open and ($high - $low). Do not divide OHLC quantities by $close: $close is adjusted while OHLC is raw, so mixing the scales is a units error that imports future dividend information.

  CS_RANK(TS_COV($return, $dollar_volume, 42) / (POWER(TS_STD($dollar_volume, 42), 2) + 1e-8))

  CS_ZSCORE($leverage) * CS_ZSCORE(TS_RANK($dollar_volume, 21))

  TS_MEAN($dollar_volume / (TS_MEAN($dollar_volume, 126) + 1e-8), 21)

  (RANK($roa) - $high / (TS_MAX($high, 189) + 1e-8)) / (TS_STD($return, 126) + 1e-8)

  RANK($roa) * (TS_MAX($high, 21) + TS_MIN($low, 21) - 2 * $open) / ($open + 1e-8)
